meta.what: Median gross rent and median household income, Colorado and its counties 1980-2000 (Census long form) plus Colorado 2005-09, 2010-14 and 2020-24 (ACS 5-year), and incorporated places in 2000. County ACS cohorts live in county-trends.json.
meta.method: Long-form income is for the calendar year before the census; median_hh_income_rent_year moves it to the rent year with CPI-U annual averages. ACS 5-year medians already state rent and income in the same dollars. Compare rent growth with income growth using median_gross_rent and median_hh_income_rent_year.
meta.comparability: Census says decennial long-form and ACS rent and income can be compared with care: ACS income is for the past 12 months and ACS is a rolling five-year sample. https://www.census.gov/programs-surveys/acs/guidance/comparing-acs-data.html
